record.context_brief: Whether stability implies the wedge bound
record.original_question: Fix an integer n and let C be one of the following matrix classes: (i) the class of matrices A_{n,k,t} for positive integers n and k and t in (0, 1), (ii) the class of GKK τ-matrices, (iii) the class of GKK matrices, or (iv) the class of τ-matrices. If a matrix A in C_n is already known to be stable, must it also satisfy the spectral wedge inequality |arg(λ - l(A))| ≤ π/2 - π/n for every eigenvalue λ of A?

evidence.quote: Mehrmann [12] showed that τ -matrices of order up to 4 satisfy the inequality | arg(λ − l(A))| ≤ π/2 − π/n ∀λ ∈ σ(A), (2), which is a property stronger than stability.
3c. For given n, do the stable matrices in class Cn satisfy (2)?

Specific classes C of interest include i. The class of matrices An,k,t for positive integers n and k, and for t ∈ (0, 1), ii. The class of GKK τ -matrices, iii. The class of GKK matrices, iv. The class of τ -matrices.

artifact.status_search_result: A 2005 result (Holtz–Tyaglov, "Not all GKK τ-matrices are stable") showed that stability itself can fail for GKK τ-matrices in the family A_{2k+2,k,t}, disproving several related conjectures. However, no source located explicitly resolves the conditional question of whether stable members of these classes must satisfy the wedge bound |arg(λ−l(A))| ≤ π/2 − π/n. The problem appears to remain unresolved in the literature available, so its current status is unknown.

status_evidence.title: Not all GKK τ-matrices are stable
status_evidence.snippet: A class of unstable GKK τ-matrices is described, disproving conjectures that positivity of principal minors plus weak sign symmetry implies stability.
status_evidence.claim: Some related conjectures on GKK τ-matrices were disproved, but the conditional wedge question is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on GKK τ-matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems including whether stable matrices in classes such as A_{n,k,t}, GKK, τ, and GKK τ satisfy the wedge inequality.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as open for these specific matrix classes.
